description: This source file defines the PaymentMethodServices class providing service methods for managing payment methods such as creation, update, deletion, and related entities (CreditCard, GiftCard, EftAccount, CheckAccount) within the OFBiz framework. It includes security checks, entity manipulations, and various payment-related operations.

classes.name: PaymentMethodServices
classes.description: Contains static methods providing services for managing payment methods, including creation, updating, deletion, and related entity management within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: deletePaymentMethod
methods.description: Soft deletes a payment method by setting its 'thruDate' to current timestamp after security and ownership checks.

methods.name: makeExpireDate
methods.description: Constructs an expiration date string from expiration month and year inputs.

methods.name: createCreditCard
methods.description: Creates new CreditCard and PaymentMethod entities with validation and security checks.

methods.name: updateCreditCard
methods.description: Updates existing CreditCard and PaymentMethod entities, with validation, masking, and security checks.

methods.name: clearCreditCardData
methods.description: Clears sensitive CreditCard data and expires the associated PaymentMethod.

methods.name: createGiftCard
methods.description: Creates new GiftCard and PaymentMethod entities with basic validation.

methods.name: updateGiftCard
methods.description: Updates existing GiftCard and PaymentMethod entities with validation and security checks.

methods.name: createEftAccount
methods.description: Creates new EFT account and PaymentMethod entities with validation.

methods.name: updateEftAccount
methods.description: Updates EFT account and PaymentMethod entities with validation.

methods.name: createCheckAccount
methods.description: Creates new Check account and PaymentMethod entities with validation.

methods.name: updateCheckAccount
methods.description: Updates existing Check account and PaymentMethod entities with validation.
